children.value: > Fact From Story: Wayne Rooney, former Everton and England forward: "Devastated to hear the sad news about Bill Kenwright. Known Bill since I was young and he's had a huge impact on me as a person and my career. Great man and a big inspiration. Thoughts are with all Bill's family and friends."
> Commonsense Knowledge: When someone says another person had a huge impact on them, they are calling that person a big inspiration.
